explanation: Count occurrences in a frequency map, sort distinct keys by descending frequency, and return the first k keys. The promised strict frequency boundary makes the top-k membership unique.
timeComplexity: O(n + u log u) time for n values and u distinct values.
spaceComplexity: O(u) frequency/sort space plus O(k) output, for u distinct values.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 JavaScript algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
